- Client updates
- Compiler updates
- Spec updates

  - discuss the DELEGATECALL issue brought up in https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/evm-object-format-eof/5727/98
- Testing updates

  - Who has "isStateTest" implemented in t8n?
  - Should we change the testing base to "Prague" and away from "Cancun"? 
- Other items

Please add other agenda items or links to discuss.

### Next call on July 24th, 2024

Spec question: Solidity would prefer to change EOFCREATE address calculation to include `input` in hashing: https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/144

**Update:** Solidity team discussed this internally, and concluded it's not too important to change https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/144#issuecomment-2233473396
I'd like to discuss the DELEGATECALL issue I brought up in https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/evm-object-format-eof/5727/98

Three items I would like to discuss for testing
* Who has "containerKind" implemented and meaningful to the test?
* Who has "isStateTest" implemented in t8n?
* Should we change the testing base to "Prague" and away from "Cancun"?
